name: AC Circuits, Power & Three-Phase Systems
summary: The second circuits course: sinusoidal steady state, complex power, resonance, coupled coils, two-ports and balanced three-phase systems.

topics.name: Sinusoidal steady-state analysis (nodal, mesh, theorems in the phasor domain)
RMS and average values of periodic waveforms
Instantaneous, average, reactive and complex power
Resonance (series and parallel) and quality factor
Frequency response of circuits and Bode plots
Magnetically coupled circuits, mutual inductance and the ideal transformer
Balanced three-phase circuits: wye and delta connections
Three-phase power and its measurement (two-wattmeter method)
Two-port networks (z, y, h and ABCD parameters)
Non-sinusoidal waveforms: Fourier series applied to circuits
